en.html:
Ichijou had a tsurugi, and was handling it quite competently. That was one surprise.
Bigger surprise: Raichou Imagawa, Lord of Oyumi.

His martial reputation I had heard about.
But an Ashikaga heir, after all. I had assumed half the great reputation was publicity arranged for the family business.

Apparently the reputation had not been inflated by even one paisa.
Ichijou was moving as well as a regular Rokuhara soldier, and still he was not letting her anywhere near him.

To my eye, he surpassed his father Moriuji, whom I had fought at Hachiman Shrine.
A completely different type, yes. But was his strength actually approaching Hikaru's...?

一条が劒冑を持ち、しかも中々に使いこなしていた
事にもだが――
　それ以上に、小弓公方今川雷蝶の強さ。

　武辺の人物と聞いてはいた。
　しかし、何分にも足利家の御曹司。轟く武名の半分
は宣伝目的で演出されたものであろうと、高を<ruby>括<rt>くく</rt></ruby>って
いたのだが。

　どうもあの公方、武人としての評価に<ruby>掛け値<rt>・・・</rt></ruby>は全く
無かったようだ。
　六波羅正規兵と比べても遜色ない動きを示している
一条に相対しながら、まるで寄せ付けていない。

　俺が見るに、八幡宮で戦った<ruby>護氏<rt>ちちおや</rt></ruby>を凌駕する。
　<ruby>性質<rt>タイプ</rt></ruby>は全く違うにせよ、光に迫る力量の持ち主では
ないのか……？

en.html:
Kuronose stood up.

He had come prepared with greaves; from the feel against my blade, I knew that.
Prepared, yes. Protected sufficiently, no.

The damage from that blow had probably reached the bone.
Still he stood. The willpower was doing work the legs had every right to refuse.

黒瀬が立ち上がる。

　用意良く脚甲を付けていたことは、刃先の手応えで
わかっている。
　が、それで防げるというものでもない。

　一撃浴びた被害は骨まで及んでいるだろう。
　それで立つのだから、大した意志力であった。

en.html:
Kageaki"You wish to fight, I will oblige. With that injury, though, the result is already showing..."
Kuronose"..."
Kuronose"…………"
Kageaki"...What happened? Why this saving and saving? Is this the occasion?"
Kageaki"Keep hesitating and your life will slip away instead."
Kuronose"You... you noticed—"
Kageaki"If you mean to fight, bring out the hidden card. Otherwise where is the satisfaction for me?"
Kuronose"Are you in your senses?"
Kageaki"More than the man practicing thrift at death's door, I should think. Life is going, still he wants to save."
Kuronose"…………"
Kuronose"This was left to me by my late father... I swore I would not use it until the day I raised the Okabe banner again and openly took up arms against the shogunate."
Kuronose"But no choice is left!"
